response.per_admitted_tick: After a supervisor death immediately after tick k, the entire speed-bounded stale-command path, fallback transition and braking volume must remain within the supported certificate and independent geofence.
response.simulation_horizon_s: max_tick_gap_wall_s * RTF_max + upper_float32(COM_OF_LOSS_T) + upper_float32(COM_FAIL_ACT_T) + declared_mode_transition_s + declared_transport_clock_s
response.hold_delay_semantics: Pinned framework excludes Action::Hold from COM_FAIL_ACT_T deferral; retaining a nonnegative delay term is conservative, not a measured transition guarantee.
response.allowed_frozen_change: Reducing COM_OF_LOSS_T with an explicit rationale tightens stale-setpoint exposure; never a relaxed threshold.

restricted_policy.critical_battery: Land=2 with complete independently bound eroded corridor

response.speed: hypot(upper(MPC_XY_VEL_MAX), max(upper(MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP), upper(MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN))) <= declared 3D speed bound
response.braking: Commanded acceleration/jerk limits are upper limits, never calibrated lower braking capability. Reject declarations exceeding relevant caps; actual stopping/tracking evidence remains required.

roles.absolute_position: Separate empirical base_link origin radius for bootstrap/geofence only; not a capture-query transform bound.
roles.relative_geometry: translation + 2*sin(rotation/2)*rho over complete support points, optical/body lever arms and footprint. Exact TTL/source/model/provenance/epoch/reset binding is mandatory.
roles.health: Per-axis estimator-health ceilings with a separately frozen operational role and rationale; no variance-to-error conversion and no chosen multiplier from heldout outcomes.
roles.relative_membership: Whole support06 derivation (433 capture / 1840 query identities); whole r39 retrospective source-disjoint evaluation (136 / 588). Same-source temporal diagnostics are explicitly not independent.

supported_rtf_min.reason: 0.196 long-window and lower short-window observations do not validate a supported workload floor. 0.12 is not automatically accepted.

clock.wall_service_rule: simulation-cadenced source: nominal_period_sim_s / supported_RTF_min + bounded_jitter_wall_s; wall-cadenced source: its own period + jitter. Preserve original simulation TTL.
clock.below_floor: RTF_OUTSIDE_SUPPORTED_RANGE is a valid revoke, never a PASS for an unrelated fault injection.
clock.human_and_tick_deadlines: Do not scale operator lease, command TTL, tick/session/request/handoff wall deadlines.

geometry.home: Frozen actual Home/local reference, epoch and xy/z/vxy/vz reset counters. Observed Home/origin/heading-reset changes latch; never silently rebind.
geometry.fence: Complete inner geofence plus stopping/uncertainty/physical/frame reserve lies strictly inside actual Home-centered outer horizontal radius and above-Home ceiling.
geometry.height_condition: NAV base_link altitude >= actual full-body support extent + 0.5 m + justified motion/uncertainty/tracking reserve. Rest/support contact is not NAV acceptance.
geometry.landing: Independent complete phase-eroded corridor covers every admitted center through designated support contact; never exempt body/rotor contacts.

fault_validity.baseline: Untampered matched baseline reaches and remains at exact target stage, actual PX4 mode/arming and output eligibility without revoke.
fault_validity.fault: Same eligible frozen profile/workload/geometry; actual injection; first revoke matches expected causal reason and suppresses output immediately.
fault_validity.masking: A revoked baseline, earlier ODOMETRY_UNCERTAINTY/RTF/unsupported-fallback failure or missing observation makes INVALID_TEST, never PASS.

required_before_operational_freeze: Justified independent health role and ceilings, separate from geometry uncertainty
Untouched source-disjoint heldout membership acquired under separately approved unarmed scope
Continuous independent truth and matching instantaneous twist, not denser-position finite differences
External conditional timing/calibration/intersample transform scope and complete rho coverage
Independent stopping/tracking dynamics under frozen full 3D speed and acceleration/jerk policy
Supported workload/RTF window/range and per-source cadence/jitter justification
Actual valid frozen Home/origin/reset context and full eroded landing/fence physical evidence
Phase-aware NAV free volume and evaluator isolation/unsafe latching
Independent actual healthy matched baseline and correctly caused injected revocations
prior_evidence: All prior protocols, bundles, raw bags and failed windows retained unchanged; no historical trace relabelled untouched.
